scenarios.name: Keep the Live workspace reachable
scenarios.when: the user switches between Live and Summary
scenarios.then: both pages and recording controls remain accessible with no Deep page

scenarios.name: Remember model choices per summary role
scenarios.given: Quick and Summary have different model choices
scenarios.then: each role keeps its own chosen model

scenarios.name: Keep Duo readable through rotation
scenarios.given: a wide iPhone window supports two panes
scenarios.when: the user rotates between portrait and landscape
scenarios.then: pane layout and the selected page survive rotation

scenarios.name: Choose Duo widths and transcript actions
scenarios.given: the phone is showing the two-pane Live workspace
scenarios.when: the user changes pane priority and opens transcript actions
scenarios.then: the requested pane balance and compact actions remain usable

scenarios.name: Save prompt presets below Notes
scenarios.given: the Notes prompt editor is open
scenarios.when: the user chooses a preset and saves summary instructions
scenarios.then: reopening Notes preserves the saved instructions

scenarios.name: Keep optional cloud processing off by default
scenarios.given: a fresh app has no selected cloud service
scenarios.when: the user explicitly selects a service
scenarios.then: only that selected cloud service becomes active

scenarios.name: Keep vault writing opt-in
scenarios.given: Save to folder has never been enabled

scenarios.name: Show the Full summary menu icon and open its sheet
scenarios.given: an iPhone or iPad conversation workspace is open
scenarios.when: the user opens More, chooses Full summary, and dismisses the sheet
scenarios.then: Full summary renders a visible purple icon beside its title, the summary sheet opens, and Done returns to the workspace without starting recording
